test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

EACH : AEHC :: GAME : AGEM :: IDOL : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) EACH : AEHC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d10f4c9c93216f93a38b78ab37910154a5899e57bf50b732952e4c4a265073ea.png] 

And,

2) GAME : AGEM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/088977203ec19a3ec3d17c45ddcbdd2e6d80c15998280bbc20c2df611c57010d.png] 

Similarly,

3) IDOL : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/712d4f2973c7cd44c0e20850caf5a1f2ae19a52fe5d1c50f5c69abd3d834b0bf.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"DILO".**
